review_candidates.title: Senior Project Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior Project Engineer – Cognitive Asset Pilot BSL | Madinaty, New Cairo | Full-Time | Immediate Start BSL is developing a new generation of Cognitive Assets — bringing together the physical environment, digital infrastructure, connected systems, automation and intelligent operation to create more responsive, efficient and experience-driven assets. Our Madinaty Executive Golf Villa is the pilot for this concept. The villa’s construction and core works are substantially complete, and the project is now entering its final delivery phase, covering fit-out, specialist installations, systems integration, commissioning and handover. We are looking for a Senior Project Engineer to take ownership of this final delivery phase and drive the asset to completion. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who can coordinate multiple specialist contractors, manage the finishing programme, control procurement, coordinate MEP and connected systems, and ensure that all elements come together as one fully integrated asset. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES * Lead the day-to-day execution of the final fit-out and completion programme. * Coordinate finishing contractors, specialist suppliers and technology partners. * Drive the critical path toward final completion and handover. * Coordinate architectural finishes and remaining MEP works. * Manage interfaces between electrical, HVAC, plumbing, low-current and smart-home systems. * Follow up procurement, material approvals and deliveries. * Review quantities, measurements and contractor progress. * Monitor workmanship and finishing quality. * Coordinate installation and commissioning of KNX / smart-home systems with specialist technology partners. * Ensure remaining MEP and digital infrastructure is properly tested before closure. * Coordinate lighting, HVAC controls, networking, security, access and other connected systems. * Manage snagging, testing, commissioning and final completion. * Maintain clear daily and weekly progress reporting. * Identify schedule, quality and budget risks early and drive corrective actions. * Prepare the asset for final owner handover, including relevant documentation, warranties and commissioning records. THE CANDIDATE We are looking for an engineer who can see the project as a complete asset, rather than simply supervise individual finishing trades. You should be comfortable working across: Fit-Out → MEP → Technology → Integration → Commissioning → Handover You should be proactive, organized, commercially aware and capable of identifying problems before they become delays. REQUIREMENTS * 5–8+ years of relevant experience. * Strong experience in high-end residential, villas, fit-out or premium finishing. * Proven ability to manage subcontractors and specialist suppliers. * Strong understanding of finishing execution and construction sequencing. * Good MEP coordination experience. * Ability to read architectural, MEP and shop drawings. * Experience with BOQs, quantity measurement and procurement follow-up. * Strong Excel and project-reporting skills. * Excellent communication, organization and problem-solving abilities. * Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of delivery. * Ability to professionally challenge contractors and drive results. * New Cairo / East Cairo / Madinaty experience is an advantage. * Own transportation is preferred. * Immediate availability or short notice is preferred. CONNECTED ASSET EXPERIENCE Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage: * KNX * Smart-home systems * Building automation / BMS * IoT / connected buildings * Lighting control * HVAC controls * Networking and low-current systems * Access control and security systems You do not need to be a technology specialist or KNX programmer. What matters is the ability to coordinate technology specialists and ensure that the digital layer is properly integrated into the physical asset. REPORTING STRUCTURE The Senior Project Engineer will report directly to the BSL Project / Asset Principal and will coordinate specialist contractors, suppliers, consultants and technology partners. The role carries responsibility for day-to-day execution and delivery, while major commercial, design and strategic decisions remain with BSL. THE PILOT ASSET The Madinaty Executive Golf Villa is intended to become a reference implementation for BSL’s Cognitive Asset concept. The successful candidate will therefore contribute not only to completing the asset, but also to establishing a repeatable delivery approach covering: * Integrated fit-out delivery * Connected-system integration * Smart-home commissioning * Quality standards * Asset documentation * Testing and handover * Operational readiness * Lessons learned for future Cognitive Assets PROJECT MILESTONE The villa is scheduled for full fit-out completion, commissioning and handover by 1 December 2026. The successful candidate will play a key role in driving the remaining programme, coordinating contractors and specialist partners, managing the critical path, and ensuring the asset is delivered to the required quality and operational standard. review_candidates.description: Who is Plenti? Plenti is a fintech lender, providing faster, fairer loans by leveraging its smart technology. Plenti is a dynamic and innovative business that is growing strongly. By continuing to deliver better customer experiences, Plenti is taking market share from incumbent players in the personal lending, renewable energy, and automotive finance markets. We are a fast moving and ambitious business that seeks to recruit smart and capable people, who can take ownership of their role to help the business thrive. With over 250 people based in Australia, Plenti is of a size where everyone can make a difference in their role and help us realise our very big ambitions as a team, as we go about building Australia’s best lender. Plenti is a founder led business that launched in 2014, listed on the ASX since 2020 with annual revenue of over $250 million and a loan portfolio of over $3 billion. About The Role At Plenti, we're building Australia's best lender — and our platform needs people who can keep it running at its best. As a Product Support Engineer, you'll be the first line of technical defence across our Personal, Auto, Green, and Investor lending products. That means diagnosing real production issues, querying databases, coordinating incident response, and building the knowledge base that makes the whole team sharper over time. This is a role for someone who's genuinely curious about how complex systems work — and motivated to leave them better than they found them. Key Responsibilities Respond to incoming support tickets, assess business impact and priority, and own issues through to resolution within agreed SLA timeframes. Investigate and resolve complex technical issues spanning application workflows, databases, and API integrations, applying data corrections and configuration updates where required. Identify and co-ordinate the response to production incidents, communicate timely status updates to affected business teams, and drive post-incident root cause analysis. Act as the primary technical liaison between customer-facing and operational teams and the engineering team, setting clear expectations on resolution timelines and keeping stakeholders informed throughout. Triage unresolvable issues to the appropriate engineering team, providing structured defect reports with reproduction steps and supporting evidence to enable fast resolution. Build and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and playbooks to improve support scalability and reduce time-to-resolution for recurring issue types. Identify patterns in recurring issues and advocate for product improvements or automation that reduce manual effort and overall support volume over time. About You 2+ years of relevant technical experience, or a strong CS/SE academic background - we welcome applications from candidates with hands-on experience in technical support, software engineering, or a similar role, as well as recent graduates with a Computer Science or Software Engineering degree and a strong academic record. Practical SQL proficiency - the ability to write, read, and review production-safe SQL queries and data-fix scripts, including an understanding of relational database concepts such as foreign keys, constraints, and transaction safety. Working knowledge of REST APIs - ability to inspect and interpret API requests and responses to diagnose data or integration issues, including familiarity with tools such as Postman or browser dev tools. Demonstrated problem-solving ability - a track record (academic or professional) of breaking down ambiguous technical problems methodically and reaching a well-reasoned resolution. Observability tooling familiarity - experience with tools such as Datadog, New Relic, or similar APM platforms is desirable but trainable; curiosity about system behaviour and performance is more important than prior tool knowledge. Clear written and verbal communication - able to translate a technical finding into a plain-language update for a non-technical stakeholder, and to write structured investigation notes that other engineers can follow. What's life like at Plenti? Working at Plenti means joining a team that is high-performing, diverse, customer-focused and collaborative. It’s a place where everyone can “make it happen” and share in the results and success. If being in a dynamic industry as part of a market-leading fintech sounds like you, then join to help us reshape Australia’s financial eco-system for the good. In return, you will enjoy a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship to take your career further. We offer flexible working and volunteer and study leave to develop your skills. We also have monthly social events, office snacks, company Townhalls and D&I initiatives and events to help you connect with your colleagues. Plenti is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We encourage people from different backgrounds to apply, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and people with disabilities. When you apply, let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process so we can accommodate you. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: UX/UI Product Designer
review_candidates.description: Be the first product designer, own the design system, and turn ordering, cashiering and inventory into screens people can operate under pressure. Share this page Our users are not browsing. A cashier at a Berlin counter and a technician quoting a repair in Riyadh are both being watched by a customer while they use what we built, and an interface that needs a second look at that moment has failed. This job is turning those workflows — ordering, cashiering, inventory, service quoting, configuration — into screens that hold up, and giving engineers specs they can build without guessing. You would be the first designer here, and the owner of the design system: tokens, variables, components and variants in Figma, kept in step with the front-end component library. The work ships in weeks, to real users, in two markets that pull in different directions — German business users who want density and a keyboard, and MENA users who want Arabic, right-to-left, on a phone. On site in Ismailia from October 2026; hybrid is negotiable for the right person. What you would do Own product design end to end across our SaaS products and client platforms — research, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, handoff. Build and maintain the design system in Figma, aligned with the front-end component library. Run lightweight user research and usability sessions with real users — restaurant staff, technicians, business owners — and change the design because of what you saw. Audit existing screens and propose UX improvements in priority order. Design for both markets: dense, keyboard-driven and compliance-aware for Germany; Arabic, right-to-left and mobile-first for MENA. Produce handoff specs, redlines and interaction notes; review what was built against the design and log the deviations. Work with the graphic designer so product UI and marketing visuals share one brand foundation. Write design decisions down, so the team can reason about them later. What we are looking for Three or more years designing SaaS, dashboard, POS, ERP or other data-dense B2B products. A portfolio of shipped work with the reasoning visible, not only the final screens. Expert-level Figma: auto layout, variables, component properties, prototyping, dev mode. You have built or maintained a design system that engineers actually used. You can run a usability session, say what you saw, and change the design accordingly. Clear written and spoken English, and the nerve to argue a design decision with engineers and founders. Nice to have Hospitality, retail or point-of-sale software. Arabic right-to-left design. German UI conventions and accessibility expectations — BITV, WCAG. Enough Angular, or any component-based front end, to read what was built. Motion and micro-interaction design. What we offer The first designer's seat, with the design system yours to shape rather than inherit. Designs in front of real users within weeks, and the research access to watch them. A senior engineering team that will build what you specify — and tell you when it will not work. Figma with AI-assisted workflows, Storybook, ClickUp, Loom. The team You would report to the CTO and co-founder, and be the designer on a team of engineers — which means your work is argued with rather than approved. There is a graphic designer beside you for the brand side, and the front-end component library your system has to stay in step with is already in production. How hiring works for this role Four steps, usually inside three weeks. An informal call with someone you would actually work with, then a walk through work you already own — never an unpaid take-home the size of a project. The form asks about a decision engineers pushed back on; bring that one. A decision within a week of the last conversation.
